# CLAXEN

> Claxen is a freelance developer who builds custom websites, Telegram and Discord bots, Python automations and AI tools. Projects range from $10 to $10,000.

## Services

- [Website development](https://your-domain.example/website-development/): Fast, responsive sites and web apps that look the part and get found on Google.
- [Bot development](https://your-domain.example/bot-development/): Telegram and Discord bots that answer, sell, moderate and run your community around the clock.
- [Python automations](https://your-domain.example/python-automation/): Scripts and backends that remove repetitive work: scraping, reports, integrations and scheduled jobs.
- [AI automated tools](https://your-domain.example/ai-automation-tools/): AI-powered tools and agents that write, summarise and decide, wired into the apps you already use.
